method: Two epic state directories share a disposable resource root with maxJobs=1. Each real Bun workload counts loop iterations for 300ms. Attempt the second job after the first publishes its process group, then retry after the first exits.
reproduce: bun test --timeout 60000 packages/toolu-core/src/resources/__tests__; tests cover the same managed CPU workload, concurrent admission and descendant ownership boundaries
limitations: A bounded local admission measurement, not a production CPU savings estimate or Linux hypervisor test. Historical steal samples are replayed separately by the resource policy test.
